description: Codex variant of hooks.json, selected by extensions.com.openai.hooks in .codex-plugin/plugin.json. One SessionStart command emits every house rule (hooks/inject-rule.sh --all, about 50 KB) with additionalContextLimit 0 so Codex keeps the whole block — the script is the cap. One command means one hook for the user to trust in /hooks. Claude Code reads hooks.json instead, because it truncates any single hook output over ~10 KB.
